title: Spine-named `egress_port_of(packet)` resolver absent — the (bundle, direction) resolution is split across `bundle_of_pipe` + `port_dir_of_packet`
detail: Spine Consistency Conventions row: "`egress_port_of(packet)` = (bundle, direction) resolution; `port_lane_count`, `port_lane_ready`, `port_lane_caps` — directional twins". The twins landed under their spine names, but `egress_port_of` exists nowhere (grep core/, app/, harness/: zero hits) — the resolution ships as two differently-named helpers.
recommended_fix: Add a thin `egress_port_of(packet) -> (bundle, dir)` wrapper over `bundle_of_pipe` + `port_dir_of_packet`, or amend the spine's Naming row to the shipped API.

title: Serve-pass enumeration pinned as direction-ascending, which enumerates `heading` node-ids DESCENDING — the spine's literal "(bundle slot asc, heading asc)" names the opposite order
detail: Spine Determinism row: "the full-duplex serve pass enumerates (bundle slot asc, heading asc)". `heading` is a node id; dir 0 (LO_TO_HI) heads toward the pair's hi endpoint (the LARGER id), so dir-ascending walks headings hi-then-lo — heading-descending. The spine itself declares the order non-load-bearing under independent budgets.
recommended_fix: Reconcile the pin: correct the code comment (or spine wording) to "(bundle slot asc, direction asc)", or enumerate dir 1 first if literal heading-ascending order was intended.
